coupled_boom.surge_note: the 70% y/y is ORDER INTAKE (incl. backlog-race and double-ordering), not underlying demand — modeled as a transient arrival multiplier, mean-reverting; NOT a demand growth rate

ramp_cap.basis: ESTIMATED — skill-formation physics: winding/assembly/test proficiency ~2-4 yr apprenticeship; sustainable mentor ratio ~1-2 trainees/master; primary evidence that personnel limit capacity: DOE 2014 ('availability of trained personnel set limits', line 1053)
ramp_cap.applies_to: utilization recovery toward nameplate AND staffing of new lines; DPA relaxes project DELAYS, not the skill cap

expansion_paths.frozen: nameplate 343 fixed; utilization free under ramp cap
expansion_paths.announced: Cox-notes expansions (Virginia Transformer, Hitachi, Siemens) — SECONDARY, capacity increments TO PRIMARY before coupled-band render; timing band announcement->first unit 30-48 mo, +12-24 mo to rated [ASSUMED]

distribution_class.tag: ASSUMED — the two DOE primaries are LPT-only (2024 report §: 'not distribution transformers'); needs its own primary before the distribution-class run (which is queued second per d020)

calibration.target: 36 mo commonly quoted, 60 mo max (DOE 2024); pre-COVID <1 yr

corridor_backlog_units.basis: Q ~= (quoted lead - B_central) x throughput; C band 650-850/yr spans US-bound supply 2019 +-13%; ILLUSTRATIVE consistency corridor derived FROM the target — using it as an input would be circular, so it is a check, never a parameter
